ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, point $D$ is on the extension line of $BC$. If $\angle ACD = 108^\circ$ and $\angle B = 45^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle ACD$ is an exterior angle of $\triangle ABC$,\\
it follows that $\angle ACD=\angle A+\angle B$,\\
Given that $\angle ACD=108^\circ$, $\angle B=45^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle A=\angle ACD−\angle B=108^\circ−45^\circ=\boxed{63^\circ}$.
